facts.business: Sangal Papers Limited manufactures newsprint, writing and printing paper, kraft paper, and a wide range of colored and speciality paper for domestic and international markets.

capacity_or_capex.item: New 4.5 MW high-efficiency co-generation turbine replacing 3 MW unit, with modernization of key plant and machinery

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Board is confident that the enhanced production capacity and improved operational efficiencies will yield significantly better financial results in the coming years.

key_risks: Inflationary pressures on key raw materials and logistics costs
